nodes.asset_description: A statue of a woman wearing a head covering and light-colored clothing is shown against a white background. The statue’s head is turned slightly to the right, and the right side of its face is visible. The background is uniformly white.

A woman with shoulder-length blonde hair sits against a black background. She wears a white long-sleeved shirt and light-colored pants. Her right hand rests on her cheek, and her left arm is bent, with her hand near her head. She looks directly at the camera.
